listing.summary: Composition oriented UI framework that provides a collection of reusable UI lements, systems, and utilities that help developers create clean interfaces without having to reinvent the wheel or rely on cumbersome vanilla implementations.
listing.aiSummary: Provides a composition-oriented UI framework with reusable widgets and utilities for mod developers.

description:
NativeUI

Composition is King.

Composition oriented UI framework that provides a collection of reusable UI lements, systems, and utilities that help developers create clean interfaces without having to reinvent the wheel or rely on cumbersome vanilla implementations. Alongside many ready-to-use widgets with extensive javadoc, there are also usage examples. For work with an LLM, an AGENTS.md is provided as well. For a list of all UI elements provided by the mod, see the README.

This is a library mod intended for mod developers, and is not a standalone mod.

Compatibility

Can be added mid-save
Can be removed mid-save

Credits

rolfosian - for providing the reflection library

AI use disclaimer
AI was used in the creation of javadoc, AGENTS.md and unit tests. I read every line written by it. twice.
Actual code was written by me or taken from Alex and modified.
